העיתון הטורקי “יני שפאק”, המזוהה עם ממשלת ארדואן, מפרסם מאמר של יחיא בוסתאן הטוען כי גם איראן וגם ישראל פועלות, כל אחת משיקוליה, להחלשת הברית החדשה בין טורקיה, סעודיה ופקיסטן.

לטענתו, התקיפות האחרונות של החות’ים וגורמים נוספים הנתמכים בידי איראן נגד סעודיה הן חלק מהלחץ שמפעילה טהראן על ריאד. מנגד, גם ישראל רואה ב”ברית מכה” איום, משום שהיא יוצרת גוש אזורי חדש ומרחיקה את סעודיה מהאפשרות לנורמליזציה ומהמערך האזורי שישראל ביקשה לבנות סביבה.

אז על מה הוא בעצם מתלונן?

Binyamin Hassin, an Israeli citizen born in Kurdistan, released after more than a decade in prison in Iraq

Binyamin (Ben) Hassin, an Israeli citizen born in the Iraqi Kurdistan region, was released today after more than a decade in prison, during which he was even sentenced to death by hanging.

Hassin was born in Kurdistan and immigrated to Israel with his family as a child. In 2014, he returned to the area to visit his grandparents, and during the war against ISIS, he joined the Kurdish forces fighting the organization.

In 2015, during a taxi ride, the driver heard Hassin speaking Hebrew and, according to reports, threatened to turn him over to ISIS. A confrontation developed between the two, the driver was injured and later died, and Hassin was arrested. In 2020, he was sentenced to death by hanging.

After a prolonged international struggle, in November 2025, a "sulha" (reconciliation) was reached with the driver's family. About $250,000 raised from donations was paid to the family, they granted him forgiveness, and the death sentence was revoked.

Today, as mentioned, Hassin was released and is expected to arrive in Israel soon.
